caveats.statement: 部分状态字段的取值可能随时间变化，历史事实表关联当前维度表会得到错误的状态
商机状态可能大小写不一致，导致分组错误
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM dim_customer WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

caveats.statement: 员工状态可能包含非active值，但问题中'active'可能指特定状态
DWS_EQUIPMENT_DAILY 和 DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY 等汇总表可能只包含部分日期或部分设备/产线的数据，查询时需注意日期范围和数据完整性。
caveats.check_sql: SELECT MIN(date) AS min_date, MAX(date) AS max_date, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS date_count FROM DWS_EQUIPMENT_DAILY;

caveats.statement: DWS_RISK_DAILY 表中的逾期库存、负毛利、逾期应收等风险指标可能只覆盖部分员工或产品，查询时需注意数据覆盖范围。
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dim_emp_id) AS emp_count, COUNT(DISTINCT dim_prod_id) AS prod_count FROM DWS_RISK_DAILY;

caveats.statement: dim_supplier 表中的 credit_level 和 status 等字段可能存在空值或非标准取值，查询时需注意。
caveats.check_sql: SELECT credit_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_supplier GROUP BY credit_level ORDER BY cnt DESC;

caveats.statement: DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY 表中的 yield_rate、first_grade_rate 等比率字段可能为 NULL 或超出 0-1 范围，计算时需处理。
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY WHERE yield_rate IS NULL OR yield_rate < 0 OR yield_rate > 1;

caveats.statement: DWS_EQUIPMENT_DAILY 表中的 oee 可能为 NULL 或超出 0-1 范围，查询时需注意。
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_oee FROM DWS_EQUIPMENT_DAILY WHERE oee IS NULL OR oee < 0 OR oee > 1;
